{
  "dataset_name": "codexglue",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "func_length_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled length of the function source code in characters, providing a smooth severity measure of code size.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "size_metric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Length is a strong smooth predictor for code-defect tasks; log-scale linearizes the relationship for SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(func.str.len())"
    },
    {
      "name": "func_newline_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of newline characters to total characters, approximating code line density.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "structural_density",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures code formatting density as a normalized score suitable for linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "func.str.count('\\n') / np.maximum(func.str.len(), 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "func_brace_balance_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized ratio of opening braces to total braces; deviation from 0.5 indicates structural imbalance.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "syntactic_balance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Brace balance is a smooth syntactic indicator useful as a linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "func.str.count('\\{') / np.maximum(func.str.count('\\{') + func.str.count('\\}'), 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "func_pointer_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Density of pointer/dereference characters (* and ->) per character, a continuous severity measure for memory-related risk.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "lexical_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Pointer-heavy code correlates with risk patterns; provides linearly useful signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(func.str.count('\\*') + func.str.count('->')) / np.maximum(func.str.len(), 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "func_branch_keyword_rate",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Frequency of branching keywords (if, else, switch) normalized by function length.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "control_flow",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Control-flow complexity is a smooth predictor for defect-style tasks.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(func.str.count('if') + func.str.count('else') + func.str.count('switch')) / np.maximum(func.str.len() / 100.0, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "func_loop_keyword_rate",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Frequency of loop keywords (for, while, do) per 100 characters of code.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "control_flow",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Loop density is a continuous indicator of computational complexity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(func.str.count('for') + func.str.count('while')) / np.maximum(func.str.len() / 100.0, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "func_error_handling_rate",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Frequency of error/return-failure indicators (return -, goto, errno, NULL) per 100 chars.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "error_handling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Error-handling density adds a smooth dimension useful for linear separability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((func.str.count('goto') + func.str.count('NULL') + func.str.count('errno') + func.str.count('return -')) / np.maximum(func.str.len() / 100.0, 1), 0, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "func_memory_op_rate",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Frequency of memory-related calls (malloc, free, memcpy, memset, alloc) per 100 chars.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "memory_ops",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Memory operation density is informative as a continuous linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((func.str.count('malloc') + func.str.count('free') + func.str.count('memcpy') + func.str.count('memset') + func.str.count('alloc')) / np.maximum(func.str.len() / 100.0, 1), 0, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "func_indent_depth_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Approximate average indentation depth using tab and 4-space counts relative to line count.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "structural_complexity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Indentation depth proxies nesting complexity in a smooth scalar form.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(func.str.count('    ') + func.str.count('\\t')) / np.maximum(func.str.count('\\n'), 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_project_qemu",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator that the source project is qemu.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "project_origin",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Project membership is a linearly informative offset for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(project == 'qemu', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "func_logging_rate",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Frequency of logging/assertion calls (log, assert, printf, fprintf) per 100 chars.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "diagnostics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Logging density gives a smooth signal that complements other lexical features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((func.str.count('log') + func.str.count('assert') + func.str.count('printf')) / np.maximum(func.str.len() / 100.0, 1), 0, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "code_risk_composite_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Holistic semantic judgment estimating risk-pattern density in the function by weighting pointer usage, memory operations, branching complexity, and error-handling density into a single normalized severity score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a high-level weighted composite that aligns with SVM linear margin direction in code-risk space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
